caveats: Values summarise forecast or satellite cells within 15 km of the CDFW port location. They do not describe conditions at the dock or at any particular fishing ground.
C-HARM probabilities describe the water column, not toxin in seafood; low values do not mean an area is safe.
Chlorophyll measures algae biomass, not toxins.
Official records are listed when their stated area may include nearby waters; the agency's wording decides where they apply.

notices.title: Annual quarantine of sport-harvested mussels
notices.summary: Sport-harvested mussels from the entire California coast, including bays and estuaries, may not be harvested for human consumption (bait only).

area.description: Along the California coast, including all bays and estuaries
area.geometry_note: Statewide; not drawn on the map.

sources.label: CDPH SN26-008: Annual quarantine of sport-harvested mussels begins May 1
CDPH SN26-018 (states the quarantine continues through at least October 31)

notices.title: Do not eat sport-harvested bivalve shellfish from Monterey County
notices.summary: CDPH advises not eating sport-harvested mussels, clams, scallops or oysters from Monterey County because of dangerous levels of domoic acid detected in mussels.

area.geometry_note: CDPH county polygon from the CDPH shellfish advisory map; the advisory applies to shellfish gathered from the county, not to a line at sea.

sources.label: CDPH recreational bivalve shellfish advisory map

notices.title: Do not eat northern anchovies from Pigeon Point to Point Lobos
notices.summary: CDPH advises not eating northern anchovies harvested between Pigeon Point (San Mateo County) and Point Lobos (Monterey County) because of dangerous levels of domoic acid. Does not apply to anchovies taken for bait.

area.description: Waters between Pigeon Point, San Mateo County (37° 11.00’ N) and Point Lobos, Monterey County (36° 31.46’ N)
area.geometry_note: The map shows the notice's official north and south latitude limits as lines drawn 30 km out from the coast (coastline from the C-HARM land/sea mask). The notice states no offshore limit; its wording controls.

notices.title: Northern anchovy: no take for human consumption, Pigeon Point to Point Lobos
notices.summary: Northern anchovies may not be harvested recreationally or commercially for human consumption in Monterey Bay (Pigeon Point to Point Lobos). Commercially taken anchovies may only be sold as dead bait; recreationally taken anchovies may only be used as bait.

area.description: Monterey Bay: Pigeon Point, San Mateo County (37° 11.000’ N) to Point Lobos, Monterey County (36° 31.461’ N)
area.geometry_note: The map shows the notice's official north and south latitude limits as lines drawn 30 km out from the coast (coastline from the C-HARM land/sea mask). The notice states no offshore limit; its wording controls. Latitudes as recorded from CDFW's Sept 11, 2026 restriction (docs/coastwatch/evidence/sources-regulatory.md).
